description: He wears a moss-grey crossed-front calf-length woven deel with gold-tan looping geometric/cloud-pattern borders at the cross-front edge, shoulders, cuffs and hem, over a cream underlayer. Dark slate-blue fitted undersleeves show beneath the broad outer sleeves. A broad reddish-brown patterned woven sash has a round metal clasp with hanging ornaments and tassels and a long fringed side end. Dark loose trousers and tall dark leather boots with gold-tan worked trim are visible. No headgear, armor or weapons appear.
